Title: Welcome
Description: Welcome to the island — a small private server where the world keeps living while you're away. Utilities hum, taxis run, and the locals have their own plans. This menu is the field guide.
HowTo: Pick a topic on the left — each page shows what it does, its commands, and how to use it.
Type /help any time to reopen this menu, or /help <topic> to get a page as chat text.
Start with Rust Quests: read the welcome note in your pack and go find the first trader.
Short on scrap? Public Works repair contracts and looting substation transformers both pay.
Cobalt runs checkpoints on the roads and at the monuments and keeps a file on everyone. Type /papers to read yours, and see the Cobalt Papers Please page before you rob one of their crates.
Notes: Something broken, confusing, or missing? Hit the Feedback button at the top of this menu and write a note — it lands straight in the owner's box.
